roadmap.title: Roadmap to Create Your Startup in Korea
roadmap.subtitle: Step-by-step guide for foreign entrepreneurs

step1.title: Get the right visa
step1.description: Before anything else you need legal permission to run a business in Korea. Here are the main visa options available to foreign founders.

step2.title: Choose a legal structure
step2.description: Corporation LLC or sole proprietorship each has different implications in terms of liability taxation and funding.

step3.title: Secure a business address
step3.description: A registered Korean address is required to establish a company. Options include virtual offices or government backed startup centers.

step4.title: Register your startup
step4.description: The official process including required documents registration offices and expected timelines.

step5.title: Open a bank account
step5.description: Often the most challenging step for foreigners. Here are the banks that are foreigner friendly the paperwork to prepare and tips to avoid rejection.

step6.title: Register for taxes
step6.description: Overview of the Korean tax system for startups including VAT and corporate tax.

step7.title: Find funding
step7.description: Korea offers generous public programs grants accelerators and venture capital firms that support foreign founders.

step8.title: Get insured
step8.description: Once you start hiring you must enroll in Korea’s mandatory insurance programs covering health pension and unemployment.

privacyPage.title: Collection and Use of Personal Information
privacyPage.subtitle: Privacy Policy
intro: V-SPACE places great importance on the protection of users' personal information and is doing its utmost to ensure that the personal information users provide online while using the company's services is protected.

Accordingly, V-SPACE complies with the personal information protection provisions of relevant laws and regulations that providers of information and communications services must observe, including the Protection of Communications Secrets Act, the Telecommunications Business Act, and the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc., as well as the Personal Information Protection Guidelines established by the Ministry of Information and Communication.

Through this Privacy Policy, V-SPACE informs users of the purposes and methods for which the personal information they provide is used and what measures are being taken to protect that personal information.
V-SPACE discloses this Privacy Policy on the first page of the homepage so that users can review it easily at any time.

The company's Privacy Policy may be changed from time to time due to changes in government laws and guidelines or changes in the company's internal policies, and procedures have been established for the continuous improvement of the Privacy Policy accordingly. Users are requested to check it regularly whenever they visit the site.

section1.title: 1. Purpose of Collecting and Using Personal Information
paragraphs: "Personal information" means information about a living individual that can identify that individual by items included in the information, such as name and resident registration number, including information that cannot identify a specific individual by itself but can be readily combined with other information to do so.

Most services are available at any time without separate user registration. However, V-SPACE collects users' personal information in order to provide better, higher-quality services, including personalized services, through member services.
V-SPACE does not disclose users' personal information without prior consent, and the collected information is used as follows.
bullets: Based on the personal information provided by users, more useful services can be developed.

When developing new services or expanding content, the personal information previously provided by existing users can be used to determine more efficiently the priority of services to be developed and to reasonably select and provide the content users need.

section2.title: 2. Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods
paragraphs: When users sign up as members to use member services, V-SPACE receives online the information essential for providing the service. The required information collected at the time of membership registration includes name, resident registration number, and email address.
In addition, for the provision of high-quality services, users may optionally enter information such as a phone number.

Sensitive personal information that may infringe on users' fundamental human rights, such as race and ethnicity, ideology and beliefs, place of origin and family origin, political inclination, criminal records, health status, and sex life, is not collected, and if it must inevitably be collected, users' prior consent will be obtained without fail.

section3.title: 3. Retention and Use Period of Collected Personal Information
paragraphs: While a user uses the services provided by the company as a member of the V-SPACE homepage, V-SPACE continuously retains the user's personal information and uses it for service provision and related purposes.

To prevent the recurrence of fraudulent use by bad members, V-SPACE may retain the resident registration number of the relevant member for one year from the date of termination of the service agreement.

emailPrivacyPage.title: Refusal of Unauthorized Email Collection
emailPrivacyPage.subtitle: Notice on Refusal of Unauthorized Collection of Email Addresses
emailPrivacyPage.intro: Please comply with the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc.
emailPrivacyPage.body: This website refuses the unauthorized collection of email addresses posted on this website by means of email collection programs or other technical devices in order to block indiscriminate emails sent by third parties to members, and please note that violations may be subject to criminal punishment under the Information and Communications Network Act.

notice.title: Article 50-2 of the Information and Communications Network Act
notice.subtitle: Prohibition of Unauthorized Collection of Email Addresses, etc.
bullets: No person shall collect email addresses by using programs that automatically collect email addresses or any other technical devices from an internet homepage where the intention to refuse collection of email addresses is clearly indicated.
No person shall sell or distribute email addresses collected in violation of paragraph 1.
No person shall use for information transmission any email address that they know is prohibited from being collected, sold, or distributed under paragraphs 1 and 2.
